1.explanation: TableExpandHeader.js is responsible for rendering the <th> that should receive the id prop. It currently drops any id you pass, so there’s no matching <th id="expand">. TableExpandRow.js then emits headers="expand" on each <td>, expecting that <th> to exist. Fixing TableExpandHeader to forward the id onto its rendered <th> (and ensuring TableExpandRow’s headers prop matches) repairs the link between cells and header for accessibility.
1.bug_scenario: When you drop an expansion column into your DataTable (via TableExpandHeader and TableExpandRow) and give it an id (for example id="expand"), the table body cells get a headers="expand" attribute but the header cell itself never renders that id on its <th>. The IBM Equal Access checker then complains “The 'headers' attribute value "expand" does not reference a valid 'id' in this document.” In short, TableExpandHeader is not emitting the id you pass in, so the cell-to-header link is broken.

2.explanation: All of the expansion logic lives in DataTable and two subcomponents: • TableExpandHeader.js renders the <th> placeholder for the expand/collapse control, but currently ignores or doesn’t apply the id prop. • TableExpandRow.js writes <td headers={expandHeader}>, so it relies on a <th id="…"> being present. • DataTable.js’s getExpandHeaderProps helper never adds an id itself, so even when using the render prop you end up with a non-matching headers reference. By updating getExpandHeaderProps (or TableExpandHeader) to generate or forward an id, and ensuring TableExpandHeader places it on the DOM, the headers attributes will point to a real <th id>, resolving the accessibility violation.
2.bug_scenario: In the expandable DataTable (e.g. the “Expansion” story), each data row renders a first with a headers attribute pointing at “expand”: … but there is no matching in the table header. TableExpandHeader doesn’t forward the id prop onto its (and getExpandHeaderProps never generates one), so the cell-level headers reference is invalid. The IBM Equal Access checker flags “The ‘headers’ attribute value ‘expand’ does not reference a valid ‘id’ in this document.”
